## fastcompile-testsel 3: usercode: drop `Clone` from `test::Input` (the rest of queue 00331)

blaze-testsel's `Choice` and `Why` no longer derive `Clone` (`crates/blaze-testsel/src/select.rs`), and blaze-testsel never clones an `Input`: `Why::Read(input)` takes it by move from `changed_input` and the selector's `read_changed`. So `pub enum Input` in `crates/blaze-usercode/src/test/select.rs` can drop `Clone`, as usercode-hot-core asked in 00331, once nothing in blaze-usercode clones one.
